sloka: नव नाग सहस्राणि कल्पितानि यथा विधि ।अन्वयुर् भरतम् यान्तम् इक्ष्वाकु कुल नन्दनम् ॥२-८३-३॥
transliteration: nava nāga sahasrāṇi kalpitāni yathā vidhi ।anvayur bharatam yāntam ikṣvāku kula nandanam ॥2-83-3॥

translations.english: As per tradition, nine thousand elephants were arranged to follow Bharata, delight of the race of the Ikshvakus as he set out.
